slides.headline: If you do it twice, automate it.

slides.label: THE MISTAKE
slides.wrong_sub: Copy, paste, forget. Repeat next Monday.

slides.label: Automation 1
slides.title: New lead reply
slides.card: When a form comes in, AI drafts a 3-sentence reply and saves it as a draft.

slides.label: Automation 2
slides.title: Late invoice
slides.card: When an invoice is 7 days late, AI drafts a polite reminder for you to approve.

slides.label: Automation 3
slides.title: Weekly report
slides.card: Every Friday, your numbers go into a sheet and AI writes a 5-bullet summary.

slides.label: Automation 4
slides.title: Idea inbox
slides.card: When you save an article, AI writes a 3-line summary and one post idea.

slides.label: Automation 5
slides.title: Client onboarding
slides.card: When a client says yes, AI drafts a welcome message and a first-week checklist.
slides.note: Start with one. Keep a human review step.

scenes.title: THE PROMPT
scenes.label: COPY THIS
scenes.text: My sheet has Date in A, Client in B, Amount in C. Write a formula that adds up Amount for one client in one month. Explain it in one sentence and tell me which cell to paste it in.

scenes.note: Use fake numbers, not client data.
